init_distributed_training: initialize distributed training with NCCL backend using SLURM environment variables or provided rank and world size
time_gpu_closure: measure GPU execution time of a callable closure using CUDA events and synchronization
create_warmup_cosine_schedule: create a learning rate scheduler with linear warmup followed by cosine annealing decay to a final learning rate
log_metrics_to_csv: create a CSV logger that writes typed metric values to a file with formatted headers and rows
gather_tensor_across_gpus: gather tensors from all GPUs into a single concatenated tensor using a custom autograd AllGather function
